GREENGAGE supports cities and regions in designing climate mitigation and adaptation policies together with their citizens. Citizen Observatories on mobility, air quality and healthy living were set up in pilot sites in Bristol, Copenhagen, North Brabant and Turano & Gerace. Their observations are combined with Earth observation, in-situ and socio-economic data.

I led the task on a governance model for citizen-based co-creation of urban climate policies. The model was developed with a systems-thinking approach, which is published in Habibi et al. (2025), *A systems thinking approach to inclusive governance*, [doi:10.1007/s44282-025-00317-y](https://doi.org/10.1007/s44282-025-00317-y).
